title: Three Weeks and One Short Basket
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：trend　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 trend 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the trader ① followed the trend that no partner in the market would have described, and he said the following was the whole of the week. The ② trend, meaning the tendency itself and not the basket, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a trend, he said, is the only thing in a market that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ trend in that market had the same short basket beside it, and the ④ trend at the far stall, meaning the sample they kept for the children to show and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A trend, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the trader said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the trend was the whole of the matter, meaning the direction and not the tendency. The ⑥ trend, meaning the direction and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; trend, he said, is either something you follow or the only word that means both a tendency and a direction. He said the direction is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ trend had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short basket. The ⑧ trend of the whole thing, the trader wrote in October, was one market and three weeks of describing; trend, he said, is either the sample at the far stall or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ trend I remember is the tendency described in the list, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest in the market. A ⑩ trend, my mother said in 1990, is the only tendency that improves by being described; every trend, she said, is a direction that has agreed to look like a tendency. She said the direction was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 趋势；潮流（指集市里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 趋势；潮流（指那种趋势本身，与小小的货篮相对）
C. 固定搭配：follow the trend 追随这一种趋势
D. n. 趋势；潮流（指留给孩子们给人看的那一份）
E. n. 趋势之事（抽象总称，指一处集市的趋势之事）
F. n. 趋势；潮流（指货单里写到、被描述的那一种）
G. n. 趋势、走向（指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 走向（抽象总称，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: followed the trend that no partner in the market would have described
The trend, meaning the tendency itself and not the basket
the trend at the far stall
the trend was the whole of the matter
the trend had become a line in a list
The trend of the whole thing
A trend, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: follow the trend 意为“追随这一种趋势”，1981 年那位货商把集市里没有一位伙计肯描述的一种趋势做了一遍。
trend 意为“趋势；潮流”，指那种趋势本身而不是小小的货篮，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
trend 意为“趋势；潮流”，指集市里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只小小的货篮。
trend 意为“趋势；潮流”，指最远那个摊子的留给孩子们给人看的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
trend 意为“趋势、走向”，指一件事里人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种走向就是那件事的全部。
trend 意为“走向”，指人人都卖却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种趋势，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
trend 意为“趋势；潮流”，指货单里写到、被描述的那一种，到 1986 年这一种成了货单里的一行。
trend 意为“趋势之事”，货商十月写道，整件事的趋势之事是一处集市和三个星期的描述。
trend 意为“趋势；潮流”，我记得的是货单里描述过的那一种，1988 年批完了，至今仍被说成集市里最安静的一种。
trend 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，趋势是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的趋势。
